And the waves of time are rushing
Gently into eternity.
All the tendons quenched,
All wishes fulfilled!
Everything that divides us,
That's it, that's it!
O night, O Christmas of salvation!
Old Sang!
I hate the brighter sound.
Christ was born,
Who chooses you as Saviour,
Shepherds of Israel!
Are they the children... are they angels?
O hear, it is the song of grace!
God has sent the Son
To our paths of life.
Beloved!
Why cry?
No, rejoice and look at me!
You think my life ends?
Can it end when it just started?
Come, you holy night,
Who brought us the light!
O holy night,
Made us happy!
Ha, his eyes are stared!
Cold hands! ...
That's death!
He's dying!
It should not be!.
So soon!
Just one more word!
Death knows no mercy!
So he wreaked violence
Get out of my arms!
He's gone!
He doesn't dare against you...
Beloved, no, I'm going from... you...
But listen to me:
Far away in the cemetery is a place,
Two linden trees are standing there,
I often sat alone ...
O remember the place!
Oh, quiet, nothing more!
If I'm denied,
And if no honest grave
I'd be brought in a holy earth...
On the way through the forest valley, deep in the shade,
Do you want to bury me?
And the priest also turns his eyes away in anger ...
He's stabbing my soul!
A woman's probably coming away
Down to the still grove,
Visit the dead friend,
And a hot tear
Sneak over her cheeks...
Ornamental drops fall
On the agreed grave ...
Oh!
O Night, the Consecration Night!.
Too much!.. Oh!.
It's done.
